messages.author: decd30055c435d87
messages.subject: Rescaling size of points
parts:
Hello, I would like to make a bubble plot, but I'm finding the points
are way too small. The points (bubbles) should be big enough so that the
labels fit within them. I tried using scale_area(to=c(1, 10)) but that
gives me this message:
Error in continuous_scale("size", "area", area_pal(range), ...) :
unused argument(s) (to = c(1, 10))

Here is the data:

long <- structure(list(age3 = structure(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L,
3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 1L, 2L, 3L,
4L, 5L), .Label = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"), class = "factor"),
age4 = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L,
3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 5L, 5L, 5L, 5L, 5L
), .Label = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5"), class = "factor"),
pct = c(62.4, 49.4, 38.6, 21.2, 10.4, 24.3, 32.6, 32.9, 31.1,
19.6, 5.3, 9.9, 15, 19.3, 18.7, 5.4, 5.6, 10.2, 21.4, 34.9,
2.6, 2.5, 3.2, 6.9, 16.4)), .Names = c("age3", "age4", "pct"
), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, -25L))

and the code:

ggplot(long, aes(x=age3, y=age4, size=pct))+
geom_point(color="white", fill="cyan", shape=21)+
scale_area(to=c(1, 10))+
geom_text(aes(x=age3, y=age4, label=pct, size=10))

One more little thing: how come the points in the legend have a letter
"a" inside them?

Thanks for the help, as always.

--

messages.subject: Re: Rescaling size of points
parts:
> Error in continuous_scale("size", "area", area_pal(range), ...) :
> unused argument(s) (to = c(1, 10))

This error message is actually pretty informative: neither scale_area
nor continuous_scale (to which the former passes data) has a "to"
argument. You probably mean "range=c(1,10)"?

And the legend entries have an "a" in them because geom_text is
contributing to the legend. You could change it to "geom_text(
legend=F, ... )" to get rid of this.

Ben
